import re
from datetime import datetime
print('datetime.now:', datetime.now(), 'year:', datetime.now().year)

paths = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/', recursive=True, entry_type='files')
# get electricity 2023 files
pat = re.compile(r'/electricity/2023-(\d{2})\.(txt|pdf)$')
files_by_month = {}
for p in paths:
    m = pat.search(p)
    if m:
        month = m.group(1)
        ext = m.group(2)
        files_by_month.setdefault(month, {})[ext]=p
print('months found:', sorted(files_by_month.keys()))
for month in sorted(files_by_month.keys()):
    print(month, '->', files_by_month[month])

import re
from datetime import datetime

now = datetime.now()
year = now.year
print('year:', year)

paths = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/', recursive=True, entry_type='files')
pat_month = re.compile(r'/electricity/(\d{4})-(\d{2})\.(txt|pdf)$')

files = []
for p in paths:
    m = pat_month.search(p)
    if m:
        y = int(m.group(1))
        mo = m.group(2)
        ext = m.group(3)
        if y == year:
            files.append({'path': p, 'month': mo, 'ext': ext})

# choose one per month: txt preferred
by_month = {}
for f in files:
    mo = f['month']
    by_month.setdefault(mo, {})[f['ext']] = f['path']

chosen = []
for mo in sorted(by_month.keys()):
    if 'txt' in by_month[mo]:
        chosen.append(by_month[mo]['txt'])
    else:
        chosen.append(by_month[mo]['pdf'])

print('chosen files (one per month):')
print(chosen)

amounts = []
for p in chosen:
    obj = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=p)
    content = obj['content'] if isinstance(obj, dict) and 'content' in obj else obj
    # extract Total Amount
    m = re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)', content)
    if not m:
        # print debug: show lines around 'Total Amount'
        lines = content.splitlines()
        ta = [ln for ln in lines if 'Total Amount' in ln]
        print('No Total Amount match for', p)
        print('Lines with Total Amount:', ta)
        continue
    num_str = m.group(1).replace(',', '')
    amt = float(num_str)
    amounts.append({'path': p, 'month': p.split('-')[-1].split('.')[0], 'amount': amt})
    print(p, '=>', amt)

total = sum(a['amount'] for a in amounts)
print('amounts:', amounts)
print('total:', total)

import re
from datetime import datetime

year=datetime.now().year
print('year:', year)

# list electricity directory recursively
paths=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/electricity/', recursive=True, entry_type='files')
# select txt for this year
pat=re.compile(rf'/electricity/{year}-(\d{{2}})\.txt$')
txt_files=[]
for p in paths:
    m=pat.search(p)
    if m:
        txt_files.append((m.group(1), p))

txt_files=sorted(txt_files, key=lambda x: x[0])
print('electricity txt files for year:', txt_files)

amounts=[]
for mo,p in txt_files:
    obj=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=p)
    content=obj['content'] if isinstance(obj,dict) else obj
    m2=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)', content)
    if not m2:
        m2=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*[:=]\s*\$?\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)', content)
    print('month', mo, 'file', p, 'total match:', m2.group(1) if m2 else None)
    amt=float(m2.group(1).replace(',',''))
    amounts.append(amt)

print('amounts:', amounts)
print('sum:', sum(amounts))
